jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Model Launches
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p>Acme AI builds reliable AI systems for businesses. This is a fictional company used in the LVLme demo.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2><p>Coordinate model launches across research, product and safety teams.</p><h2>Responsibilities</h2><ul><li>Own launch plans and timelines for new model releases</li><li>Run launch reviews and keep risks visible to leadership</li><li>Work with safety teams on evaluation sign-off</li></ul><h2>You may be a good fit if you have</h2><ul><li>5+ years of program or project management in a technical environment</li><li>Experience running cross-functional launches with many teams</li><li>Clear written communication</li></ul><h2>Strong candidates may also have</h2><ul><li>Experience with machine learning products or evaluation</li><li>A degree in a technical field</li></ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$190,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$240,000 USD</span></div></div></div>
